source_scope: Official ATLUS Japanese Persona 3 character directory, restricted to its nine explicitly named character profiles: Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Mitsuru Kirijo, Akihiko Sanada, Fuuka Yamagishi, Aigis, Koromaru, Ken Amada, and Shinjiro Aragaki. The generic unnamed protagonist and all characters from other Persona titles or later editions not present in this original Persona 3 directory are excluded.
source_claim: The official original Persona 3 character directory lists the nine named profiles in scope.
provenance: First-party ATLUS Persona 3 official Japanese character page reviewed 2026-09-30; exact text labels retained as roster and mapping candidates.
notes: Original Persona 3 directory scope only; no extension to Reload, FES, or other Persona works.
